text.neutral:
Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from Ironbark Workshop. When unloading, the cartons should stay upright and off any damp floor. The corner protectors in our packaging are recycled and can be put in paper recycling. You may notice a new letterhead on our documents; nothing else about them changes.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Rafi
Ironbark Workshop
--
This message was sent from a shared mailbox.
